item.title: Stand your ground
item.description: In business (and in our personal lives) people are always quick to say “you have to do it this way” or “you will only make it to the top if you climb the ladder the way the rest of us had to” and I have just never understood it. You don’t have to do things the way they have always been done. Yes, there are certain steps you have to take to be successful.
